findings.note: RotoWire notes (Nov 3–5) say Avdija has topped 20 points in six straight games at 24.3 PPG over that run. They also say he has taken over the main offensive load while Ja Morant is out with a hamstring injury, which raises his usage. His last game was 21 points with 12 assists.

In the Oct 27 game against these same Lakers, Avdija scored 23 points (8-15 FG, 3-7 FT) in 33 minutes, just under 23.5. Morant played in that game and also scored 23, so Avdija's role may be bigger now.

The ESPN preview for the Nov 6 NBA Cup game lists Avdija's season averages as 23.4 PPG, 32.4 MPG and 66.7% from the free-throw line. That puts his average almost exactly on the 23.5 line, and his weak free-throw shooting is one way he could fall short.
